w7d6xcy2.baseName: COSTWAY 5FT Pre-lit Snow Flocked Christmas Tree With Lights-White
w7d6xcy2.variantName: COSTWAY 5FT Pre-lit Snow Flocked Christmas Tree With Lights-White
w7d6xcy2.sourceDescription: The Christmas tree is pre-lit with warm white LED lights, featuring 8 customizable lighting effects: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on. For a more lifelike appearance, this slim pencil tree is designed with snowy branch tips made from premium flame-retardant PE & PVC, creating a lush and realistic fir look. Assembly is simple thanks to 2 detachable trunk sections and a foldable metal stand with a pre-installed bolt. Gloves are included to help protect your hands during setup. Ideal for adding festive charm, these slim Christmas trees serve as a vivid and classic centerpiece for homes, apartments, storefronts, or offices. Note: Ornaments are not included! A little flocking may shed during first setup, gentle handling works best! Adjustable Light Modes: The pre-lit Christmas tree is equipped with warm white LED lights to create a bright holiday atmosphere. With 8 lighting modes, including slow fade, flashing, and sequential modes, it is easy to adjust the display to match different celebrations or personal decorating styles. Gorgeous Snowy Look: Designed with branch tips, the pre-lit holiday tree presents a lush and lifelike shape. The snow-flocked leaves paired with hidden snowy wires enhance the seasonal look, filling your room with a charming winter touch. 100% New PE & PVC Materials: Made from 100% new PE & PVC materials, the tree leaves are smell-less and flame-retardant for added peace of mind during use. The selected material also resists fading, allowing the artificial Xmas tree to maintain its fresh and beautiful appearance over time. Convenient Setup & Storage: The metal stand comes with a pre-attached bolt to help speed up installation and ensure precise alignment. Included gloves offer extra protection while arranging the branches. Plus, the foldable stand and 2-section trunk make it easy to take apart and store after the holidays. Suitable for Various Settings: With its slim pencil profile, the Christmas tree fits neatly into living rooms, apartments, offices, and corners without taking up too much space. Whether used for seasonal decorating, family gatherings, or holiday parties, it adds a lively and festive accent to any indoor environment. Specifications Colour: White, Green Material: PE, PVC, Metal Product Dimensions: 45 x 150cm Tree Width: 45cm Diameter of Stand: 35cm Number of Branch Tips: 407 Number of LED Lights: 130 Cord Length: 300 cm Number of Sections: 2 Net Weight: 3kg Is Assembly Required: Yes Box QTY: 1(May vary by batch) Package Includes: 1 x Christmas Tree 1 x Pair of Gloves 1 x User Guide Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

nxjh3gbc.variantName: COSTWAY 5 FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Branch Tips-Green
nxjh3gbc.sourceDescription: Adorned with pre-lit LED lights, you can choose between warm white or colorful hues. Also, the Xmas tree provides 11 dazzling lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood, including: A slow flash, B steady on, B quick flash, A/B colour changing quick flash, A/B colour changing slow flash, A/B colour changing 5 times, A/B Colour changing slow fade, A/B steady on, and more. Designed for stress-free assembly, the hinged branches spread out effortlessly, supported by a sturdy foldable metal base, while included gloves help you shape each branch safely and neatly. Crafted from 100% new, flame-retardant, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free PVC, this holiday tree is a realistic centerpiece for cozy holiday decorations. Note: Ornaments are not included. Merry Christmas! Lush Full Look: Create an instant holiday centerpiece with Christmas tree that looks full from every angle. It features lush branch tips and rich greenery PVC leaves, giving you that natural, abundant fir look without the mess. Charming Lighting Show: Turn your space into a glowing winter wonderland with pre-lit LED lights. Choose between warm white and colorful lighting, then switch through 11 lighting modes for the perfect mood. The Xmas tree’s convenient light controller lets you fine-tune the sparkle in seconds. Fast Setup, Easy Handling: Make holiday decorating stress-free with this artificial Christmas tree. The hinged connection helps the branches expand automatically, while the folding metal stand keeps it stable. Plus, the included gloves help protect your hands as you fluff and arrange the branches for a neat, beautiful finish. Premium PVC Material: Crafted from 100% new PVC material, this pre-lit Christmas tree offers comfort and a worry-free holiday feel. It is flame-retardant, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free, so you can enjoy the season without concerns or unpleasant smells. Versatile for Every Holiday Moment: More than a traditional decoration, this full Christmas tree fits multiple scenes and celebrations. Whether you’re styling a living room, setting up a party corner, decorating a dorm, or creating a welcoming storefront vibe, it blends beautifully with your holiday theme. x9m560bf.variantName: Neo 36PCS Christmas Tree Ornaments Set -  Frosted Pink
x9m560bf.sourceDescription: Transform your home into a festive wonderland with our stunning Neo Christmas Tree Ornament Decorations. Perfect for Christmas, parties, and even Halloween tree decorations, these dazzling baubles and glitter balls bring sparkle and sophistication to any setting. Whether you're decking the halls or hosting a holiday event, these copper-orange ornaments will elevate your décor with timeless elegance. Add a magical touch to your festive celebrations with these sparkling Christmas ball ornaments. Whether you prefer a traditional, modern, or whimsical theme, our Christmas bauble decorations are designed to make your tree shine brighter than ever. For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep ornaments, hanging strings, hooks and any small components out of reach of young children and pets due to potential choking, ingestion and entanglement hazards. Adult supervision is recommended when children are present. Ensure all decorations are securely attached to the Christmas tree to reduce the risk of items falling. Discontinue use of any ornament that becomes cracked, broken or develops sharp edges. Keep decorations away from open flames, candles, heaters and other direct heat sources. Take care when attaching and removing ornaments and avoid positioning them where they could create a trip or entanglement hazard. Retain packaging and product information for future reference. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
